entries.german:
Proschko von Rakow verkauft den Herren Peter und Johann van Rosenberg und der Rosenberger Pfarrkirche das Dorf Quassow nebst drei Zinsholden im Dorfe Nirschlern um 70 Schock Prager Groschen.

Ego Proczko dictus de Rakow vnacum heredibus meis tenore presentium recognosco publice protestans vniuersis, quod matura deliberacione sanoque amicorum meorum consilio prehabitis ac de consensu et bona voluntate domine Juthe consortis mee dilecte de meis liberis hereditatibus villam integram Quassow dictam et tres incolas seu homines censuales in villa Korithy nunccupata cum agris cultis et incultis censibus emendis honoranciis robotis siluis rubetis promontoriis aquis aquarumve decursibus pratis pascuis communitatibus utilitatibus singulis juribus et prouentibus ac pleno dominio omnique libertate ab antiquo ad eam spectantibus, prout ipsa omnia in suis metis limitata sunt et distincta, nobi libus dominis Petro et Johanni de Rosemberg et ecclesie parrochiali in Rosemberch rite et legittime uendidi pro septuaginta sexagenis grossorum Pragensium denariorum jure hereditario ad habendum vtifruendum regendum possidendum perpetuis temporibus pacifice libere et quiete, velut egomet et antecessores mei eadem bona hucusque ornni cessante impedimento tenui et tenuerunt, quas quidem septuaginta sexagenas grossorum memoratas me fateor integraliter et ex toto percepisse. Volens igitur dictos dominos et ecclesiam in Rosemberch in huiusmodi empcione certos reddere et securos, ipsis amicos meos karissimos strennuos dominos videlicet Jaroschium de Styekna et Marchquardum de Poresching dictorum bonorum fideiussores et disbrigatores duxi statuendos, promittens nichilominus bona fide vnacum eisdem manu coniuncta indiuisim, eadem bona cum singulis suis pertinentiis superius ennarratis a quolibet homine ea impetente seu impetere volente disbrigare et omnimode libertare iuxta ritum et formani juris terre regni Boemie hactenus obseruatam. In casu vero, ubi dictum Proczkonem priusquam dominam Jutham conthoralem ipsius viam vniuerse carnis ingredi contingeret, extunc nos Jaroschius de Stiekna et Marchquardus de Porziessin fideiussores antedicti promittimus bona fide absque dolo dictam empcionem et bona post mortem ipsius Proczkonis a prefata domina Juta sorore nostra eo modo et jure, ut premittitur, libertare et disbrigare. Si vero, quod absit, eadem bona cum omnibus suis appendiciis superius expressis disbrigare et libertare non possemus, extunc de tot et tam bonis nostris liberis hereditatibus, provt dicta bona se extendunt, parte tercia superaucta prefatis dominis ac ecclesie in Rosemberch condescendere ipsosque desuper transducere promittimus et debemus omni occasione et contradictione procul motis. In casu, quo nos eciam in huiusmodi bonorum disbrigacione aut aliorum in tercia parte plus valentium condescensione contrarii essemus et negligentes, extunc ambo, quamprimum moniti fuerimus, quiuis cum vno famulo et duobus equis in ciuitate Chrumpnaw in hospicio nobis specialiter deputato obstagium debitum et consuetum tenebimur obseruare, in eodem tam diu continuantes, quousque omnia premissa vnacum dampnis exinde contractis, que legittime et probabiliter poterint demonstrari, totaliter per nos expleta fuerint et persoluta cum effectu. Nos quoque Jarosschius de Stieknye et Marchquardus de Poresching supradicti recognoscimus, nos esse veros et legittimos predictorum bonorum disbrigatores, promittentes bona nostra fide omnia et singula superius contenta dolo et fraude absentibus fideliter adimplere. Vt autem cuncta premissa in singulis suis punctis et clausulis rata peramneant atque firma, sepedictis dominis et ecclesie in Rosemberg presentes damus litteras nostrorum roboratas appensione sigillorum. Sub anno domini millesimo trecentesimo septuagesimo quinto die sancti Bartholomei apostoli gloriosi.

Siegel: Drei kleine, an Pergamentstreifen hängende Siegel in weissem Wachs. a) Schild mit einem Hirschgeweih (?). - + S . Proczko . De . Rachow. b) Schild mit einem Pfeil. - + S. Jarosii . De . Stiekna. c) Das bekannte Siegel Marquard's von Poreschin.
entries.english: I, Proczko called von Rakow, together with my heirs, publicly acknowledge and declare to all by this present letter that, after mature deliberation and sound counsel from my friends, with the consent and goodwill of my beloved wife Jutha, I have duly and lawfully sold from my free hereditary property the entire village called Quassow, and three rent-paying tenants in the village commonly called Korithy, to the noble Peter and Johann von Rosenberg and the parish church at Rosenberg. The sale is for 70 sexagenae of Prague-groschen pennies. It includes cultivated and uncultivated fields, rents, dues, services, woods, brush, hills, waters and streams, meadows, pastures, commons, utilities, all rights and revenues, and full lordship and freedom historically belonging to the property, as all of it is defined by its boundaries. The buyers may hold, use, govern, and possess the property hereditarily forever, peacefully, freely, and without disturbance, as I and my predecessors have held it until now, and I acknowledge that I have received all 70 sexagenae in full. To make the lords and church secure in their purchase, I appoint my beloved friends, the valiant Lords Jarosch von Stiekna and Marquard von Poreschin, as guarantors and legal defenders of the property. In good faith, jointly with them, I promise to clear and defend the property and all appurtenances against anyone who asserts or attempts to assert a claim, according to the established form and custom of the land law of the Kingdom of Bohemia. If I should die before my wife Jutha, the aforesaid guarantors promise in good faith, without deceit, to clear and defend the purchase and property after my death against my wife on the same terms. If, which God forbid, we cannot clear and defend the property with all its appurtenances, we promise to transfer to the lords and church free hereditary property of equal value, increased by one third, and to put them in possession of it without delay or objection. If we fail or are negligent in clearing the property or conveying other property of the increased value, both guarantors, as soon as summoned, must keep the customary surety in a lodging specifically appointed for them in Krumau, each with one servant and two horses, and remain there until we have fulfilled all these terms and paid any resulting damages that can be lawfully and reasonably demonstrated. We, Jarosch von Stiekna and Marquard von Poreschin, acknowledge that we are the true and lawful guarantors and defenders of the property and promise faithfully, without deceit or fraud, to fulfill every term above. To make all these provisions valid and firm forever, we issue this letter to the aforesaid lords and church at Rosenberg, confirmed by the attachment of our seals. Given in the year 1375 on the feast of the glorious Apostle Bartholomew. Three small wax seals hang from parchment strips: one has a shield with what may be a stag's antlers and the legend “S. Proczko de Rakow”; one has a shield with an arrow and belongs to Jarosch; the third is Marquard von Poreschin's known seal.
